exercises.title: Install Node.js LTS and verify it
exercises.problemHtml:
Exercise 1 asks you to install Node.js and npm, then prove they work. Put the steps in order. (On macOS/Linux you may use a version manager such as nvm, but the order of ideas is the same.)

Tip: read every option before choosing — the wrong options are real mistakes students make in the FE exam.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All questions must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:

Mẹo: đọc hết các lựa chọn rồi mới chọn — các phương án sai đều là lỗi thật sinh viên hay mắc trong đề FE.

Yêu cầu

  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Install Node.js LTS and verify it — answer key

1. Order the steps
   Answer: a) Download the LTS installer from nodejs.org  →  b) Run the installer, keeping "Add to PATH" checked  →  c) Open a NEW terminal window  →  d) Run node -v and see a version such as v22.x  →  e) Run npm -v and see a version number
   Download → install → new terminal → node -v → npm -v. / Tải → cài → terminal mới → node -v → npm -v.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Tải LTS → chạy trình cài (giữ tuỳ chọn thêm vào PATH) → mở terminal MỚI → node -v → npm -v.

exercises.title: Read the terminal
exercises.problemHtml:
Five terminal outputs you will meet on day one. Pick what each one means and what to do next. Reading error messages calmly is half of programming.

Tip: read every option before choosing — the wrong options are real mistakes students make in the FE exam.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All questions must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Năm kết quả terminal bạn gặp ngay ngày đầu. Chọn ý nghĩa và việc nên làm tiếp. Bình tĩnh đọc thông báo lỗi là một nửa của lập trình.

Mẹo: đọc hết các lựa chọn rồi mới chọn — các phương án sai đều là lỗi thật sinh viên hay mắc trong đề FE.

  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

2. 'node' is not recognized as an internal or external command (Windows)

5. Which version line should you install for FER202?

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Read the terminal — answer key

1. node -v prints v22.11.0
   Answer: a) Node is installed; this is its version
   v22 is an LTS line. / v22 là dòng LTS.

2. 'node' is not recognized as an internal or external command (Windows)
   Answer: b) The terminal cannot find node: open a new terminal; if still failing, add Node to PATH or reinstall
   Usually just an old terminal session. / Thường chỉ là phiên terminal cũ.

3. npm -v prints 10.9.0
   Answer: a) npm comes with Node and works
   npm is bundled with the Node installer. / npm đi kèm bộ cài Node.

4. zsh: command not found: npx on macOS right after installing
   Answer: b) Restart the terminal (or reload the shell profile) so PATH is refreshed
   Same idea as on Windows. / Cùng ý như trên Windows.

5. Which version line should you install for FER202?
   Answer: b) An even-numbered LTS release
   Even majors become LTS (18, 20, 22…). / Major chẵn trở thành LTS (18, 20, 22…).
